instruction.text: Select the area of the thermometer that would contain negative numbers.
Sort the following numbers into the order they would appear on the thermometer above.

feedback.end: Numbers below 0 on a thermometer indicate temperatures below freezing.

instruction.text: Press the lift buttons that would take you to the floors below ground level.

atoms.a: Alice is on the 3rd floor of a shopping centre in London. She wants to buy some shoes from a shop on floor -2. How many floors down does she need to go?
Alice now wants to have some lunch in the food court on the 5th floor. How many floors up does she need to go?
Alice is now ready to leave, but her car is parked 3 floors below ground level. How many floors down does she need to go?

feedback.finish: The floors below ground level are typically labelled with negative numbers.

instruction.text: Select the lines that show expenses in the following bank statement.
Calculate the overall money earned according to the bank statement.
Calculate the overall money spent according to the bank statement.

feedback.end: If you spend more money than you earn, your bank account will show a negative balance. This number shows the amount of money you owe to the bank.
